title: Manage Game Default
caption: Default loaded Manage Game view for a supported library title.
instructions: Open a game in the Steam library and wait for the Manage Game view to finish loading.

title: Manage Game Report Detail
caption: Manage Game detail view showing the selected report preview and actions.
instructions: From Manage Game, open one report and pause on its detail view.

title: Manage Game Hardware Compare
caption: Side-by-side comparison between the report hardware and our current system.
instructions: From the report detail view, open the Our System comparison modal.

title: Manage Game Edit Modal
caption: Edit modal used to change RAM, notes, and other report-derived launch settings.
instructions: From the report detail view, choose Edit and capture the modal with fields visible.

title: Manage Configurations Default
caption: Manage Configurations screen with profile controls and launch option toggles.
instructions: Open the Manage Configurations page from the plugin sidebar.

title: Compatibility Tools Tab
caption: Compatibility tools screen showing discovered Proton versions and actions.
instructions: Open the Compatibility Tools page from the plugin navigation.

title: Compatibility Tools Release Picker
caption: Compatibility tools picker focused on Proton release selection.
instructions: Open the Compatibility Tools page and open the version browser.

title: Logs Viewer
caption: Log viewer modal with scrolling content and actions visible.
instructions: Open the Logs tab and bring up the full log viewer.

title: Settings General
caption: Main settings page showing the general configuration controls.
instructions: Open the Settings tab and keep the default general settings section visible.

title: Cache Manager Modal
caption: Cache manager modal used to inspect and clear plugin cache state.
instructions: Open the Cache Manager modal from Settings.

title: Settings Language Selector
caption: Settings flow while changing the plugin language and verifying translated UI.
instructions: Open Settings and open the language selector.

title: Issue Reporting Template Selector
caption: About page with the issue template selector opened for choosing the report type.
instructions: Open the About tab and open the issue template selector.

title: About Tab
caption: About page with project summary and project links.
instructions: Open the About tab from the plugin navigation.
